sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Learned counsel for the petitioner files a memo seeking permission to withdraw the petition, with liberty to file fresh petition on the same cause of action.
2.

The memo reads as follows:
"The petitioner in the above case has not filed some of the documents along with the writ petition, therefore, petitioner humbly prayers that this NC: 2024:KHC:14763 Hon'ble court may be pleased to allow the petitioner to withdraw the above case with liberty to file fresh petition for the same relief in the interest of justice."
In terms of the memo, the writ petition is disposed as withdrawn along with I.A.No.1/2024, as a consequence.
